verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth documents adding an account by tapping "+" and scanning the QR code, after which the app shows the generated token. It also explicitly generates TOTP codes on iOS and Android and works offline. missing for 10: a dedicated first-party walkthrough of the QR-add flow (the only mention is on a token-checking troubleshooting page), and independent or hands-on corroboration that codes appear immediately after scanning.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account

citations.quote: Tap the “+” button in the app and scan the QR code or rewrite the service key manually and compare the results with the generated token.
Generate TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard codes on iOS, Android and via browser extensions.
